terms.opentdb: Open Trivia DB: CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribute opentdb.com, share alike). No key. One request per 5 s per IP, max 50 questions per request, type=multiple; use a session token (api_token.php?command=request, expires after 6 h idle; response_code 4 = exhausted, 5 = rate limit). Level 3 has no own difficulty: use hard.
terms.triviaapi: The Trivia API: CC BY-NC 4.0 - free for non-commercial use only, commercial use needs a paid subscription; credit the API somewhere discreet. No key for English text_choice questions; max 50 per request; 20 requests per 5 s per IP (429 above). Sessions, images, translations need a key. Level 3 = hard (the pack also uses isNiche for level 3).
